about.title: About

about.description_1: I'm a Tech Lead and Senior Full-Stack Engineer with {{years}}+ years building and owning a multi-tenant telecom and fintech platform serving ~{{brands}} white-label MVNO brands in Mexico. I specialize in enterprise platforms with a strong focus on <hl>{{backend}}</hl> for web platforms and APIs, and <hl>{{mobile}}</hl> for cross-platform and native mobile solutions.

I lead engineering teams, run high-availability AWS infrastructure, and own systems end to end — from schema and APIs to mobile clients and the CI/CD that ships them.

mvno_core.title: Multi-Tenant MVNO Core Platform
mvno_core.desc: The business-support system behind ~28 white-label mobile carriers: subscriber lifecycle, SIM provisioning, number portability, billing and payments. 108 tables, 371 REST endpoints and a tenant-tree multi-tenancy model with encrypted per-tenant carrier credentials. Largest contributor: 2,094 of 6,649 commits.

payments.title: Unified Multi-Gateway Payment Platform
payments.desc: Ten payment processors plus OXXO cash references consolidated behind a single charge protocol with per-gateway error persistence and webhook handling. Includes a 26-reason dealer balance ledger with pessimistic locking, a configurable anti-fraud rate limiter and CFDI/SAT e-invoicing.

carrier_integrations.title: Carrier Provisioning & Telecom Integrations
carrier_integrations.desc: The integration layer connecting the platform to Mexico's mobile network: Altán Redes provisioning (~40 operations — activation, suspension, IMEI lock, HSS profiles), a second MVNE (OXIO), SFTP batch ingestion of CDR and mobility reports, the number-portability clearinghouse and CFDI/SAT e-invoicing — 18 vendor clients standardized on one contract.

kmp_app.title: Kotlin Multiplatform Consumer App
kmp_app.desc: Led the migration of the consumer mobile ecosystem to Kotlin Multiplatform: one shared codebase (336 files) for Android and iOS with Clean Architecture — 54 use cases, 43 screens, 30 ViewModels, Swift interop and server-driven runtime theming across 6 brands. Authored 63% of the codebase.

pos_android.title: Retailer & Dealer POS Android App
pos_android.desc: Point-of-sale app for the dealer network: SIM activation, customer signup, number portability, IMEI verification and balance purchases. 17 product flavors from one codebase, six payment processors integrated natively and ZXing barcode scanning. Top contributor: 232 of 559 commits.

admin_crm.title: Telecom Admin CRM
admin_crm.desc: The internal operations CRM: 118 models, 337 routes and 187 components with shared CRUD base classes, a bitmask-driven permission system and dashboards with chart and PDF export. Deployed per tenant via GitLab CI to S3 + CloudFront. Top contributor: 1,554 of 5,899 commits over 6.5 years.

aws_infra.title: Multi-Client AWS Cloud Infrastructure
aws_infra.desc: Architected and operated the AWS footprint for ~28 white-label brands — 100+ deployments spanning admin CRMs, dashboards, public top-up portals and APIs. Multi-AZ high availability: EC2 Auto Scaling behind ELB, Multi-AZ RDS (PostgreSQL), S3 + CloudFront, Route 53 failover, VPC isolation and CloudWatch monitoring.

resume.title: My
resume.subtitle: Resume

platform.label: Platform Ownership
platform.text: Owned the core multi-tenant Ruby on Rails MVNO platform (108 tables, 203 models, 371 REST endpoints, ~95K LOC production / ~151K LOC tests) powering ~28 white-label telecom brands — largest contributor with 2,094 of 6,649 commits. Architected multi-tenancy as a tenant tree with encrypted per-tenant carrier credentials and cascading theme settings.

payments.label: Payment Systems
payments.text: Unified 10 payment gateways (Openpay, Stripe, Conekta/Digital FEMSA, MercadoPago, Kushki, Clip, Toku, DPCard, DPVale, Beel) plus OXXO cash references behind a single process/commit charge protocol with per-gateway error capture, making each new processor a contained change.

carriers.label: Carrier Integrations
carriers.text: Built the Altán Redes provisioning integration (~40 operations: activation, suspension, IMEI lock, number portability, HSS subscriber profiles), SFTP batch ingestion of CDR/mobility/NIR reports, a second MVNE (OXIO), Mexico's number-portability clearinghouse and CFDI/SAT e-invoicing — 18 vendor clients standardised on one contract.

reliability.label: Reliability & Correctness
reliability.text: Engineered a 26-reason retailer balance ledger with pessimistic row locking, an anti-fraud rate limiter with six configurable rules, a retry library with exponential backoff and bounded webhook redelivery, and concurrency-capped job queues (95 jobs / 18 queues / 24 schedules) tuned to carrier API limits.

aws.label: AWS Cloud Infrastructure
aws.text: Designed and operated multi-AZ, high-availability AWS infrastructure for ~28 white-label brands and 100+ platform deployments — EC2 Auto Scaling behind Elastic Load Balancing, Multi-AZ RDS (PostgreSQL), S3 static hosting fronted by CloudFront, Route 53 DNS with health-check failover, ACM-managed TLS, VPC isolation and CloudWatch monitoring.

mobile.label: Mobile Leadership
mobile.text: Led the Kotlin Multiplatform migration, authoring 63% of the codebase (242 of 386 commits) — Clean Architecture + MVVM with 54 use cases, 43 screens and 30 ViewModels shared across Android and iOS, Kotlin/Native↔Swift interop and runtime theming. Automated white-label releases via fastlane to Play Store and TestFlight, with per-brand secrets injected from HashiCorp Vault at build time.

standards.label: Standards & Mentorship
standards.text: Established GitLab CI with RSpec (432 specs), RuboCop, Brakeman/Snyk SAST, 42Crunch, an 8,423-line OpenAPI spec and OpenTelemetry tracing across 146 releases. Mentored engineers through code review, training and onboarding; led architecture decisions across backend, mobile and frontend.

platform.label: Core Contributor
platform.text: Grew into a core contributor on the Ruby on Rails API and Ember.js CRM that became the company's flagship telecom platform, taking ownership of subscriber lifecycle, billing and dealer-network features.

mobile.label: Android Sales App
mobile.text: Built and maintained the retailer/dealer Android sales application in Kotlin (MVVM, Room), which went on to ship across 17 white-label brands.

onboarding.label: First Production Work
onboarding.text: Joined the team building corporate telecom platforms with Ruby on Rails and Ember.js; delivered first production contributions to the customer-facing self-service portal.
